text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gran Alegria hasn't been feeling well lately,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A good night's sleep is all I need!
I'll be right back to my 100-mile-an-hour self.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mnh...? 
Huh, where are we...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Get 'em cheap, cheap prices here!
Freshly picked vegetables at bargain prices!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Clerk
text_block_list.text: Today's recommendation is the 0.000125-mile sized carrot~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Are those two over there
Taiki-senpai and Flight-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flight!
Good morning-mile!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Good Mile-ning♪ ...Oh, by the way.
The thrift shop nearby is having a sale, you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Get this—an amazing 40 Mile% off!
Wanna go check it out?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In that case, I want a jacket, yes!
Clothes around 5,000 mile-yen would be great, you know~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whaa?! All the units are miles?!
And people greet each other with "Good Mile-ning"?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So many miles, full-on smiles!
I can't believe such a wonderful world exists!

text_block_list.name: Italian Chef
text_block_list.text:
"Gather 'round, pizza's hot out of the oven!
One of the world's biggest—a special one-mile-long pizza!
Is there any true miler out there who can finish it?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, pick me! Pick me!
I'll eat e~very single bite!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Nom nom nom nom nom nom nom nom!

text_block_list.name: Italian Chef
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you've gotta be kidding me... She really ate the whole thing!
To think such an incredible miler existed...!

What extraordinary passion for the mile...!
I am truly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Minister of the Mile
text_block_list.text:
I am the Minister of Miles for this country.
You truly deserve the People's Honor Mile Award!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The National Mile Honor Award...! Understood! I'll carry this nation's miles on my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—H-Huh?
Was that... a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahaha!
Somehow—I feel like running a mile right this second!
